preconditions.description: The input integer n must be within the range (-∞, 100].

postconditions.description: If n is zero or negative, the function returns an empty string.

postconditions.expression: n > 0 and all(len(line) == len(return_value.splitlines()[-1]) for line in return_value.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For positive n, all lines in the returned pattern have the same length, equal to the length of the longest line.
For positive n, the pattern has exactly (2n - 1) lines.

postconditions.expression: n > 0 and all(line == ''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, k + 1)) + ''.join(str(i) for i in range(k - 1, 0, -1)) for k, line in enumerate(return_value.splitlines(), 1) if k <= n) and all(line == ''.join(str(i) for i in range(1, k + 1)) + ''.join(str(i) for i in range(k - 1, 0, -1)) for k, line in enumerate(return_value.splitlines(), n + 1) if k <= 2 * n - 1)
postconditions.description: For positive n, the first n lines form an ascending pyramid (1, 121, 12321, ...), and the remaining (n - 1) lines form a descending pyramid (1234321, 12321, 121, ...). Each line k is constructed as the concatenation of numbers from 1 to k followed by numbers from (k - 1) down to 1.
